qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialized offshore vessel fleet and engineering know-how, but completely lacks pricing power. Fixed-price turnkey EPC contracting model repeatedly exposes company to severe cost overruns, inflation shocks, and contract write-downs.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Turnkey EPC contractor business model relies on competitive fixed-price bidding with unhedged cost inflation and execution risk, resulting in repeated multi-billion euro contract losses and massive dilutive recapitalizations (2016 €3.5B, 2022 €2.0B).
qualitative.evidence: Through-cycle ROIC is negative/sub-hurdle due to chronic project write-downs on legacy lump-sum turnkey projects. Chronic execution blowouts required massive dilutive rights issues in 2016 and 2022 to prevent insolvency.
